_comment: The wire contract between TracebackFormatter.java and execClient.ts, which nothing else checks — TypeScript cannot type a socket, and on 1.4.3 the two sides had disagreed on every field name for four releases without a single failure. `zeroDivision` and `syntaxError` are COPIED VERBATIM from TracebackFormatterTest, which asserts these exact strings against real Jython 2.7.4 output; if the server changes, that test fails first and this file is re-copied from it, never edited to match. `libraryFrame` is hand-built, because a unit test has no project library to raise from — but its `<module:util.helpers>` spelling is the one MEASURED on a real gateway in spike S1, and it is the only shape that makes a frame clickable.
